name: Kuuhaku no Kioku
source:
There is a girl who has lost memory. To regain it hero needs to use hypnotherapy to follow the flow of her memories. There are three girls each with a unique story.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一个失去记忆的女孩。为了重新获得它，英雄需要使用催眠疗法来追踪她的记忆流。三个女孩每个人都有独特的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
